description: Concrete product, data, runtime, and delivery acceptance criteria across Roots 1 to 5 (#28 D1, #1747).

criteria.statement: Staging and production deploy through one mechanism, and no deploy starts while a long Dagster job runs.
criteria.threshold: 0 failures in 30 consecutive deploys; production at most 1 failure in its last 10 deploys

criteria.statement: A merged PR reaches staging through the pipeline with no manual repair, and production promotes a verified staging tag.
The S&P 500 is the next production tier after TOPT and QQQ. While scheduled in an environment, its head advances every scheduled day and names every missing cell.
No fetch key is fetched twice per environment per day.
criteria.pending_on: #1411 K3: N-PORT archive, OpenFIGI, and price-lane dedupe

criteria.statement: Every seat's daily spend stays within its environment share of its vendor account, and no core-path key ends deferred_capacity.
criteria.threshold: 0 days over share; 0 core-path keys deferred

criteria.statement: Every production price has two origins or a named reason, and the corroborated share stays calibrated.
criteria.threshold: every price has two origins or a named reason

criteria.statement: Every listing resolves to its primary exchange and stock basic profile through the identity store across TOPT, QQQ, and S&P 500.
criteria.threshold: 1 key and basic profile per listing across universes

criteria.statement: The risk-free rate and consensus growth come from scheduled sources with lineage.
criteria.pending_on: consensus growth scheduled source (#1418); risk-free rate backed by #1255

criteria.statement: Sampled production values trace through snapshot and observation to raw.fetches bytes whose sha256 matches S3.
criteria.threshold: at least 20 sampled values per night; 0 mismatches

criteria.statement: S&P 500 membership comes from IVV N-PORT holdings resolved through the identity store.
Production TOPT and QQQ ticks run on schedule and land fresh governed heads with named reasons for gaps.
Every research module (Q1-Q6) serves values with calibrated confidence for applicable constituents in staging and production.
criteria.threshold: high actionable coverage without single-source confidence inversion

criteria.statement: Sentinel known answers compare nightly against independent oracles in mart.oracle_outcomes.
criteria.threshold: outcome rows exist for sentinel rows on staging and production

criteria.statement: Numbers compare across origins and classifications with 95% upper error bound at or below 1%.
criteria.threshold: at least 600 compared values; 95% upper bound <= 1%

criteria.statement: PEG supports historical geometric CAGR and forward conventions with App and MCP switching.
A refused issuer never rolls back valid issuers of the same deployed tick.
Module actionable coverage on scheduled universes meets accepted service objectives.
Every research module produces governed values with calibrated confidence and zero false reds in nightly verdicts.
Variant strategy definitions run via CLI, Dagster trigger, REST, and MCP and appear on /research/backtest bound to their hash.
Backtest history covers at least 60 months with total return from explicit corporate actions.
Strict PIT anti-lookahead guard guarantees every backtest input was knowable before its cutoff.
The nightly backtest runs on schedule and produces governed valuation curves without pending gaps.
Authenticated session and MCP bearer boundary enforce 401 on unauthenticated access and mart_readonly isolation.
No deployed module imports or ships Fixture classes.
MCP tools, Company reports, ETF virtual company reports, and cards render real governed mart data and save to /research/library.
criteria.threshold: all card kinds and ETF report backed by live mart

criteria.statement: /admin and /admin/datahub show freshness, actionable 6-scenario construction progress, confidence breakdown, and verdicts with no stale fake greens.
Per environment, App, MCP, and card surfaces align with the governed served head and backtest binding.
Generated 1080x1440 Xiaohongshu cards across all universes and card kinds resolve and pass RLS checks.
A verdict that has not run within its cadence or is missing shows explicit STALE or MISSING state on /admin.
criteria.threshold: 0 stale or missing verdicts displayed as pass

criteria.statement: App, MCP, and saved Xiaohongshu cards serve all 6 scenarios with honest progress and lineage citations.
criteria.threshold: end-to-end 6-scenario consumer loop live on Staging
